en-US.title: Eat unlimited Hanwoo for 45,000 won per person
en-US.description:
Kawabe at the Riverside Hotel near Sinsa Station, Seoul

It is an all-you-can-eat sukiyaki and shabu-shabu restaurant.

The main meat is Hanwoo neck meat, and the price is good.

It costs 45,000 won per person.

Although it is labeled as 1++ grade, it is neck meat, and when you eat it, it doesn't quite have the same feel as Hanwoo sirloin.

However, you have to consider everything in terms of value for money, so at this price point, it seems to have a solid position.

Refills are quick, and the staff are generally friendly.

It is a bit of a shame that the ceiling is low.

The udon is good, and as for the sushi I ordered extra, I don't think I'll need to order it again next time.

en-US.title: A house where you crawl out after going out to eat
en-US.description:
Lee Kyung-moon Sundae Gopchang in Jongno, Seoul
The sundae gopchang stew is so hearty,
it's a place I crave especially in the winter. 🥘

It's a stew with sundae (Korean blood sausage) and pork tripe.

It's a bit salty, so adding water to adjust the seasoning might be a good idea,
but the portion is quite generous. 😄
It's hard to finish a small order for two people.

However, the pork tripe portion is quite high,
so if you don't like pork tripe, I wouldn't recommend it. If you do, I recommend it. 🐖

It's recommended to order the fried rice.

Stir-fry it yourself.

Sundae Gopchang Stew Small 33,000
Fried Rice 2,000
